scope: Fixed post-hoc scientific-value analyses on previously inspected development patients; not preregistration, external validation or algorithm promotion

tuning.selection: Highest mean of fifteen inner-fold AUROCs; exact numerical ties within 1e-12 prefer stronger regularization (smaller logistic C, larger ridge alpha; LDA auto then descending numerical shrinkage)
tuning.preprocessing: Fit ranks and StandardScaler within each inner training partition; refit selected model on the complete outer training partition only
tuning.outer_policy: Original five seeds and five folds; full multiscale feature columns for every comparator; retain frozen C, D and fixed-parameter baseline test scores as controls

mechanism.quality_control: Original 4-second six-channel block-power caches; peaks <500 uV; preserve original block indices and only form sequential pairs with index difference exactly one

features.lag1: Pearson correlation of global theta block powers at physically adjacent retained blocks
features.neg_increment: Negative mean absolute change of physically adjacent global theta powers divided by mean retained global theta power
features.residual_corr: For each bilateral pair, regress left and right powers separately on the mean theta power of the other four channels with intercept; correlate residuals and average three pairs. This is a statistical common-mode control, not source connectivity or reference reprocessing.

mechanism.joint_shuffle: Permute retained time blocks jointly for all six channels within patient; preserve marginal and cross-channel paired power distributions and physical QC slot mask, while destroying temporal ordering
mechanism.independent_right_shuffle: Permute each right channel independently within patient; only channel marginals are preserved, not global block means or cross-channel pairing
mechanism.surrogate_evaluation: Report per-patient feature surrogate summaries and joint-shuffle invariance; refit C and D for plus_lag1 and plus_increment on every joint-shuffle replicate using original outer partitions. Surrogates are not diagnostic label permutations or external patients.
mechanism.orientation: Freeze each outer-training raw-feature Pearson sign shared by all six transformations; equal feature weights; no test-label preprocessing
mechanism.winsorization: Per-feature outer-training 5th/95th percentiles, clip then training StandardScaler
mechanism.asinh: Training median/MAD centering and scaling, fallback to training SD then 1 for degenerate columns; asinh then training StandardScaler
mechanism.gaussian_rank: Training midpoint empirical ranks with normal quantile mapping clipped at 0.5/n and 1-0.5/n
mechanism.inference: Transformation controls test dependence on marginal spacing, tails and normalization; no causal neural mechanism or uniquely established shrinkage explanation is claimed

uncertainty.method: Conditional patient-paired Dirichlet bootstrap of mean within-fold AUC; shared patient weights across five appearances and compared models; independent cohort streams for equal macro
uncertainty.multiplicity: Exploratory fixed contrasts, no confirmatory significance or winner selection

stopping: Complete this menu once, preserve adverse and null outcomes, do not expand models, hyperparameters or surrogate controls in response to test scores. Refuse overwriting output.
